jobs.title: Self Application
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Pixelmatters is a digital product studio. We’re a team of strategists, designers, and engineers creating top-quality digital products.

Our mission is to empower businesses to achieve their full potential by delivering high-quality digital products while fostering strong relationships. We envision a world where great user experience is the norm, inspiring businesses and people to perform at their best.

Requirements

We are always looking for talented people. If there are no Jobs open but you still think you have what it takes to join us, don't think twice and send us the best things you've done to prove you deserve an opportunity.

Benefits

  • Quality-driven, inspiring, and collaborative work environment.

  • Competitive salary and benefits, including health insurance.

  • ClaudeCode account with generous tokens’ budget.

  • We have a brand new office located at Porto’s downtown while continuing to back our “Remote as default, Office as an option” policy.

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Description

Pixelmatters is a digital product studio. We’re a team of strategists, designers, and engineers creating top-quality digital products.

Our mission is to empower businesses to achieve their full potential by creating top-quality digital products, while fostering great relationships along the way. We envision a world where great user experience is the norm, not the exception, inspiring businesses and people to be at their best.

We’re looking for you — an autonomous, curious, and flexible Design Engineer with a genuine obsession for how interfaces feel, not just how they look.

Your role sits at the intersection of design and engineering. You'll build websites as systems of reusable blocks, assemble templates and pages from them, and prepare the CMS that powers them. You’ll create the interactions, micro-interactions, and animations that make our work feel alive, and when a mockup leaves something unspecified, you're the person who decides what happens between the states. We work with agentic AI tools as a team, which means the mechanical parts of this work keep getting faster, and your judgment becomes the part that matters most.

Some of your day-to-day tasks will include building, maintaining, and optimizing websites across different tech stacks, from design handoff to live delivery, ensuring quality, performance, accessibility, and security on every launch. You'll work closely with designers to bring interactions and animations to life, and use agentic AI tools daily to speed up the repetitive parts of the work. You'll be hands-on with code while keeping an eye on the bigger picture, understanding how your technical decisions impact the end product and the user experience.

You're someone who takes pride in the end result and holds yourself to a high standard, not because someone asked, but because that's how you work.


Requirements

  • At least 3 years of experience as a Front-End Engineer or Design Engineer.

  • Solid grasp of semantic HTML, modern CSS, and SEO fundamentals.

  • Experience with React and Next.js, including building websites as systems of reusable components.

  • Experience implementing interactions, animations, and micro-interactions.

  • Experience working with Content Management Systems (Payload CMS and/or WordPress, but others are valuable), including modeling content structures and preparing content migrations.

  • Fluency with agentic AI tools (such as Claude Code or Cursor) as a regular part of your development workflow.

  • Ability to deliver solutions that meet high standards of performance, accessibility, and cross-browser and device compatibility.

  • Familiar with version control systems such as Git.

  • Effective and clear communication with engineers and designers.

  • Good understanding of English and Portuguese (written and spoken).


It would be awesome if you also have...

  • Proficiency using utility-first libraries such as Tailwind CSS, and component libraries such as shadcn/ui.

  • Experience extending AI tools rather than just using them, such as writing custom skills and commands, building MCP integrations, or setting up agent-based workflows.

  • Experience with motion libraries such as Motion (Framer Motion) or GSAP.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits, including health insurance.

  • We have a brand new office located at Porto’s downtown, while continuing to back our “Remote as default, Office as an option” policy.

  • Agentic AI tooling provided from day one, including a Claude Code license and a shared library of team-built skills, commands, and integrations.

  • A design-led environment where craft is the standard, and where engineers work side by side with designers rather than downstream of them.


Compensation

  • The salary range from this role is between €32,485.00 to €53,485.00 annual gross, which includes meal, vacation and Xmas allowances.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Description

Pixelmatters is a digital product studio. We’re a team of strategists, designers, and engineers creating top-quality digital products.

Our mission is to empower businesses to achieve their full potential by creating top-quality digital products, while fostering great relationships along the way. We envision a world where great user experience is the norm, not the exception, inspiring businesses and people to be at their best.

We’re looking for you — a great communicator, flexible, and autonomous Product Manager. A team player who likes to work in a fast-paced environment.

Client relationships are key at Pixelmatters. We have a mixed reality of product and project development in which we proudly collaborate with our clients, some of whom have internal design, development, and product teams with established processes. We embrace the challenge of building trustworthy remote relationships using the power of communication. We care about standing out by quality, having a voice, and a strategic mindset. Now, we're looking to expand the Product team. And here is where you come in...

Your role is focused on interacting with clients and teams to make great products. You're an open-minded, resilient, and self-driven individual who loves digital products. You're a persuasive, clear, and emphatic communicator who cherishes the value of proactive and open communication with our clients and collaborators. You understand the value of a good and organized working process, being flexible and able to adjust to each client's needs and reality. You're creative and organized, a strategist who seeks to have an impact.

Some of your day-to-day tasks will include active communication with our clients, managing their expectations, scope accomplishment, sharing strategic ideas to empower their businesses, and serving as a bridge to our internal teams. You'll be responsible for the scope and process specifications, and by negotiating these with our clients. You’ll also manage the backlog and elaborate strategies to tackle it with Design and Engineering teams.

Requirements

  • At least 4 years of professional experience as a Product Manager or in a comparable product-related position

  • Clear, cohesive, and proactive communicator

  • Great understanding of English and Portuguese (written and spoken)

  • Capability to create empathy and build trust among different stakeholders

  • Experience negotiating scope, capacity, and timelines with stakeholders

  • Passion for the IT industry and for Product development

  • Experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows to enhance efficiency and product outcomes

  • Capability of detecting problems and turning them into opportunities

  • Broad understanding of web technologies and their development lifecycle

  • Capability to specify small and incremental deliverables based on product requirements and vision

  • Capability to discuss trade-offs that promote the highest value for the product

  • Understanding of skills and strengths of teams

It would be awesome if you also have...

  • A background in a technical field, such as software engineering, or prior experience in a similar area is a significant advantage

  • Flexibility in understanding products’ position in different markets, identifying potential opportunities and product gaps

  • Worked with design teams and highly demanding UI projects

  • Experience defining processes and strategies from the ground up based on end goals provided by clients and inputs from the team

  • Track record as Product / working with remote teams

  • Experience in Agile environments and methodologies

Benefits

  • Quality-driven, inspiring, and collaborative work environment, where Good is not good enough.

  • Benefits package, including health insurance.

  • A beautiful office located at Porto’s downtown, while continuing to support our “Remote as default, Office as an option” policy.

Compensation

  • The salary range for this role is between €34,585.00 to €45,785.00 annual gross, which includes meal, vacation and Xmas allowances.
